description: Add a PDF the user has (for example a paper from their library's subscription) to their football-docs library. Only PDF files are read; the text stays on this computer and is never sent anywhere. Returns a local: ID for read_paper and match_quote, which give only the outline and short passages of such papers.

id.description: The paper's DOI or arXiv ID, to fill in its title and authors. Found in the PDF when omitted.

path.description: The full path to the PDF, for example /Users/me/Downloads/paper.pdf or ~/Downloads/paper.pdf.

name: add_local_paper
